# Naturalist

Author: LiterallyElbowTTV

Revision: 1

Catalog: area52\-v1

License: CC0-1.0

Category: Leveling

Role: PLAYER\_ROLE\_HEALER · Primary stat: STAT\_SPIRIT

## Description

```text
### OVERVIEW
Plant healing seeds upon your allies and nurture their growth!

As a Naturalist, you'll rejuvenate your party with a range of healing-over-time effects, caring for them until it is time for them to bloom, resulting in massive bursts of healing. 

Maintain and manage your seedlings to keep your party moving forward!
```
